summary.text: Nancy Jenkins-Arno is a Republican state representative from Michigan House District 34 who took office on January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She previously represented District 57 in the Michigan House from 2011 to 2017.

paragraphs.text: Nancy Jenkins-Arno graduated from Evangel University in 1986 and earned a master's degree in political science from the University of Toledo in 1991.
Her professional experience includes working as a real estate title examiner.

Ballotpedia lists her prior office as Michigan House of Representatives District 57, where she served from 2011 to 2017; in the 2011-2012 through 2015 sessions she served on the Appropriations Committee, and she also sat on the Commerce and Trade Committee in 2015.
She returned to the Michigan House on January 1, 2025, advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026, and in the 2025-2026 session sits on the House Appropriations Committee.
